errors.evidence: The description of the chart's purpose is overly generic and does not state what the chart specifically represents, which is the relationship between ROUGE-2 score and the amount of data (数据量).
The description incorrectly states the y-axis range is from 21.49 to 33.43. This is the range of the data values, not the axis scale, which visibly ranges from 22 to 34.
The y-axis tick interval is 2 (with labels at 22, 24, 26, etc.), not 1 as stated in the description.
The first data point's x-coordinate is not 0. It is located at a value slightly greater than 0 on the x-axis, approximately 1000.
The second data point's x-coordinate is not 5000. It is located at a value slightly greater than 5000, approximately 6000.
The description omits a data point on the line. After the point at (20000, 31.31), there is another point at approximately (30000, 31.57) before the final point at (40000, 33.43).
